question: Can actual same-slab dual-ended Timing time difference and prompt-relative mean be calibrated in independent real-muon controls, with explicit full denominator and position support?
controls: Single long track; leading highest pz0 50<pz0<2000GeV, >=7layers, chi2/ndof<10, finite actual X/Y_atTrig with abs<1000mm to exclude placeholder999999; no neutrino truth/energy input.
strict: Both original end status exactly0, finite localtime>0; derived timing/position NaN otherwise. Positive finite rawQ only within timewalk calibration; signed rawQ retained for all rows.
reference: Veto21 strict original status0, finite localtime>0, positive rawQ for relative-mean calibration.
mapping: Actual per-source CableMapping at run (data CONDBR3, MC OFLP200 tag05); first4 Timing hardware entries sorted as actual ntuple producer and hRandomCharge titles if present. Require same plate opposite PMT per pair. Missing mapping rejects feature, not event.
time_coordinate: local acquisition times only. Same-board difference cancels common clock phase. Retain clockPhase/bcidtime/triggertime only as QA; do not subtract phase a second time. Relative mean uses Veto21, not an unanchored absolute time.
fit_split: Original input entry even calibration, odd validation; finite same-file conditional validation, not independent run transfer.
target_difference: tL-tR; report effective slope, sign and x_light residual. No physical shower-centroid label.
target_mean: (tL+tR)/2-tRef minus conventional straight-slope path: data dz*sqrt(1+tx^2+ty^2)/c, MC dz*(sqrt(...)-1)/c; dz1598.9mm. Actual material/clock-transfer uncertainty not thereby certified.
ranges: Only training min/max charge and x/y ranges support later application. No weak-signal extrapolation or thresholds tuned on nu energy.
pilot_admission: All actual identities and required schema present or explicitly unsupported; exact original Stage129 run/event prefix for controls where available; GNU complete CPU threefold 4096/256 plus300audit reserve within1200.
failure_policy: Unknown/missing support remains. Do not change source/fit family/quality gate; no energy training until physically supported calibrated observables and whole-cohort coverage have separate contract.
preserve: Stage87/all original gates; pz0-only first-power momentum; px/py/q/p/bending allowed; raw11/typedNaN/signed/status0 timing/Calo missing; pz>50GeV/allK/roles/reserved/quarantine/Stage54
